blurb.text: A sub-GI of the Okanagan Valley, in British Columbia. The Okanagan is Canada's second-largest wine area and, with the Similkameen Valley, makes more than 80 percent of the province's wine. Merlot and Pinot Noir are the most planted grapes in the province.

sources.name: Wikipedia, Okanagan Valley (wine region), the opening of the article
